content.query:
traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message startswith "GameStarted"
| extend d = parse_json(tostring(customDimensions))
| summarize Games=count(), AvgPlayers=round(avg(todouble(d.PlayerCount)),1), AvgBots=round(avg(todouble(d.BotCount)),1)

let games = traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message startswith "GameStarted"
| extend d = parse_json(tostring(customDimensions))
| extend GameId = tostring(d.GameId), PlayerList = parse_json(tostring(d.Players))
| mv-expand p = PlayerList
| extend PlayerName = tostring(p.Name), IsBot = tobool(p.IsBot)
| project GameId, PlayerName, IsBot;
let wins = traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message startswith "GameEnded"
| extend ed = parse_json(tostring(customDimensions))
| project GameId = tostring(ed.GameId), WinnerName = tostring(ed.WinnerName), WinnerIsBot = tobool(ed.WinnerIsBot);
games
| join kind=leftouter wins on GameId
| summarize
    GamesPlayed = dcount(GameId),
    Wins = dcountif(GameId, PlayerName == WinnerName),
    Losses = dcountif(GameId, isnotempty(WinnerName) and PlayerName != WinnerName),
    InProgress = dcountif(GameId, isempty(WinnerName))
    by PlayerName, IsBot
| extend WinRate = iff(Wins + Losses > 0, strcat(tostring(round(100.0 * Wins / (Wins + Losses), 0)), "%"), "-")
| extend Player = strcat(PlayerName, iff(IsBot, " 🤖", ""))
| project Player, GamesPlayed, Wins, Losses, InProgress, WinRate
| order by GamesPlayed desc
content.title: Player Stats

content.query:
traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message startswith "GameStarted"
| summarize Games=count() by bin(timestamp, 1d)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: 📈 Games Per Day

content.query:
traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message startswith "GameEnded"
| extend d = parse_json(tostring(customDimensions))
| summarize AvgDurationSec=round(avg(todouble(d.DurationSeconds)),0), MedianDurationSec=round(percentile(todouble(d.DurationSeconds),50),0), AvgTurns=round(avg(todouble(d.TurnCount)),0), MedianTurns=round(percentile(todouble(d.TurnCount),50),0), GamesCompleted=count()
content.title: ⏱️ Game Duration & Turns

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name contains "GameHub"
| where client_CountryOrRegion != ""
| summarize Sessions=dcount(client_IP) by client_CountryOrRegion
| order by Sessions desc
content.title: Players Map

content.query:
let playerIps = requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name contains "GameHub"
| extend IP = client_IP
| distinct IP, client_City, client_CountryOrRegion;
let playerNames = traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message startswith "GameStarted"
| extend d = parse_json(tostring(customDimensions))
| extend PlayerList = parse_json(tostring(d.Players))
| mv-expand p = PlayerList
| where tobool(p.IsBot) == false
| summarize PlayerName = take_any(tostring(p.Name)) by placeholder = 1;
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name contains "GameHub"
| extend City = client_City, Country = client_CountryOrRegion, IP = client_IP
| summarize Requests=count(), LastSeen=max(timestamp) by Country, City, IP
| order by LastSeen desc
content.title: Players by Location & IP

content.query:
traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message startswith "GameEnded"
| extend d = parse_json(tostring(customDimensions))
| extend WinnerIsBot = tobool(d.WinnerIsBot)
| summarize Wins=count() by WinnerType=iff(WinnerIsBot, "🤖 Bot", "👤 Human")
content.title: Win Rate: Human vs Bot

content.query:
traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message startswith "CardPlayed"
| extend d = parse_json(tostring(customDimensions))
| where tobool(d.PlayedAsMoney) == false
| extend CardType = tostring(d.CardType), ActionType = tostring(d.ActionType)
| extend CardLabel = iff(CardType == "Action", ActionType, CardType)
| summarize Count=count() by CardLabel
| order by Count desc
| take 15
content.title: Most Played Card Types

content.query:
traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message startswith "ActionResponse"
| extend d = parse_json(tostring(customDimensions))
| extend ResponseType = tostring(d.ResponseType), PlayerIsBot = tobool(d.PlayerIsBot)
| summarize Count=count() by ResponseType, PlayerType=iff(PlayerIsBot, "Bot", "Human")
| order by Count desc
content.title: Action Responses (JSN vs Pay)

content.json:
## 🎮 Game Drill-Down
Click a game row to see its full timeline.

content.query:
traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message startswith "GameStarted"
| extend d = parse_json(tostring(customDimensions))
| extend GameId = tostring(d.GameId)
| extend PlayerList = parse_json(tostring(d.Players))
| mv-apply p = PlayerList on (
    summarize PlayerNames = strcat_array(make_list(strcat(tostring(p.Name), iff(tobool(p.IsBot), " 🤖", ""))), ", ")
)
| join kind=leftouter (
    traces
    | where message startswith "GameEnded"
    | extend ed = parse_json(tostring(customDimensions))
    | extend GameId = tostring(ed.GameId)
    | project GameId, Duration=strcat(tostring(toint(todouble(ed.DurationSeconds))), "s"), Turns=tostring(ed.TurnCount), Winner=tostring(ed.WinnerName), WinnerIsBot=tostring(ed.WinnerIsBot)
) on GameId
| project Timestamp=timestamp, GameId, GameCode=tostring(d.GameCode), PlayerNames, Duration=coalesce(Duration, "in progress"), Turns=coalesce(Turns, "-"), Winner=coalesce(Winner, "-")
| order by Timestamp desc
content.title: All Games

content.query:
traces
| where customDimensions.GameId == "{SelectedGameId}"
| where message startswith "GameEnded"
| extend d = parse_json(tostring(customDimensions))
| project Duration=strcat(tostring(toint(todouble(d.DurationSeconds))), " seconds"), Turns=tostring(d.TurnCount), Winner=tostring(d.WinnerName), WinnerIsBot=iff(tobool(d.WinnerIsBot), "🤖 Yes", "👤 No"), Players=tostring(d.PlayerCount), Bots=tostring(d.BotCount)
content.title: 🏆 Game Result: {SelectedGameId}

content.query:
traces
| where customDimensions.GameId == "{SelectedGameId}"
| extend d = parse_json(tostring(customDimensions))
| extend Event = extract(@"^(\w+)", 1, message)
| extend PlayerName = tostring(d.PlayerName)
| extend Turn = toint(d.TurnNumber)
| extend CardInfo = strcat(tostring(d.CardType), iff(isnotempty(d.CardName), strcat(": ", tostring(d.CardName)), ""))
| extend Label = case(
    Event == "GameStarted", "🎮 Game Started",
    Event == "GameEnded", strcat("🏆 ", tostring(d.WinnerName), " wins!"),
    Event == "CardPlayed", strcat(PlayerName, " → ", CardInfo),
    Event == "ActionResponse", strcat(PlayerName, " ", tostring(d.ResponseType)),
    Event)
| project Timestamp=timestamp, Event, Turn, Player=coalesce(PlayerName, "-"), IsBot=iff(tobool(d.PlayerIsBot), "🤖", "👤"), Label, CardType=tostring(d.CardType), CardName=tostring(d.CardName), Response=tostring(d.ResponseType)
| order by Timestamp asc
content.title: 📋 Game Timeline: {SelectedGameId}
